# muontrap v1.8.0 - Table of Contents

> Keep your ports contained

## Pages

- [MuonTrap](https://muontrap.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [MuonTrap](https://muontrap.hexdocs.pm/MuonTrap.md): MuonTrap protects you from lost and out of control OS processes.
- [MuonTrap.Daemon](https://muontrap.hexdocs.pm/MuonTrap.Daemon.md): Wrap an OS process in a GenServer so that it can be supervised.
- [MuonTrap.Options](https://muontrap.hexdocs.pm/MuonTrap.Options.md): Validate and normalize the options passed to MuonTrap.cmd/3 and MuonTrap.Daemon.start_link/3
